description: Energy consumption data of office building and energy production data of a 185KW PV plant is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Alessio Cavadenti, Francesca Santori (ASM). The dataset includes two-year monitoring data from the energy consumption of and office building located in center of Italy. The building has HVAC system, heat pumps for space heating /cooling (overall 120-140 KW load) and lighting subsystems controlled individually and/or overall by BMS. Coverage: national (IT); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
